fallbackTitle: Kuusinkijoki river catchment restoration begins in Kuusamo
fallbackDescription: A local river association and the company Hiilipörssi are blocking mire ditches and building wetlands so that less humus and fewer nutrients reach the river.

fallbackTitle: Tornio River water level live at the river mouth
fallbackDescription: Haparanda has installed radar sensors along the Tornio River. The readings are online in real time and are meant to show flood risk early, especially in spring.

fallbackTitle: Syöte National Park BioBlitz: 1,549 species in 24 hours
fallbackDescription: About 50 experts searched Syöte National Park for 24 hours in August. More than half of the species they found had never been recorded in the area before.

fallbackTitle: Sakatti mine and Viiankiaapa: compensation plan falls short
fallbackDescription: Metsähallitus and the Finnish Supervisory Agency (LVV) say AA Sakatti Mining's plan to compensate for harm to the protected Viiankiaapa mire is not enough.

fallbackTitle: Open wilderness huts in Finland: rules for hikers and groups
fallbackDescription: Open wilderness huts in Finland's national parks are free shelters for hikers. Tour companies may not lodge their customers in them, Metsähallitus says.

ogCard.line: Wilderness huts are not for tour groups

fallbackTitle: Kilpisjärvi: reindeer grazing and arctic pollinators
fallbackDescription: A long-running Kilpisjärvi experiment found that reindeer grazing changes flower and insect relationships on the fells more than added nutrients do.
